commands.name: flowctl
commands.description: Install, update or remove the FlowCTL overlay app
commands.output:
/flowctl init                 install or update the overlay app (downloads the release of this plugin's version)
/flowctl init --force         install it again
/flowctl init --from-source   build it from the tagged source instead (macOS only; needs pnpm, Node 22 and Swift)
/flowctl uninstall            remove the app

tools.name: FlowPlan
tools.description: Declare or update your plan as steps with dependencies, so the person can follow it as a live graph. Call it when work has 3 or more steps: once with all steps, then again whenever a step starts, finishes or a new one appears. Steps are matched by id; steps you leave out are kept. Steps that can run in parallel should not block each other. The person watches progress live: when you start a step, mark it in_progress; as soon as it is done, mark it completed, one update per step rather than all at the end.

notes: ./register.ts hooks: session.start, command.run{command=flowctl}, session.end, prompt.submit, prompt.compose, turn.start, turn.complete, tool.call, tool.check, agent.spawn, classic.*

./register.ts hooks on prompt.compose, classic.* do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them

./register.ts calls: $.agent.list, $.clock.after, $.command.register, $.env.get, $.fs.list (via lookForNewer), $.fs.read (via overlayIo), $.fs.stat (via overlayIo), $.fs.write (via flushRecording, publish), $.http.fetch (via overlayIo), $.process.run (via findTerminal, hostPlatform, installContext), $.session.id, $.session.messages (via rebuildFromTranscript), $.tool.list (via choosePlanTool), $.tool.register (via choosePlanTool), $.ui.status, $.ui.toast (via lookForNewer, openOverlay, publish, startOverlay)

./register.ts env reads: APPDATA, FLOWCTL_RELEASE_BASE, HOME, ITERM_SESSION_ID, LOCALAPPDATA, MAESTRI_TERMINAL_ID, OS, TEMP, TERM_PROGRAM, TERM_SESSION_ID, TMP, USERPROFILE, WT_SESSION, __CFBundleIdentifier
